message.content: In one of the discussions, Li Hua mentioned a scene that stood out for him in The Witcher 3. Specifically, she highlighted the scene in the "Battle of Kaer Morhen." This battle, according to Li Hua, really showed the impact of their relationships and teamwork between Geralt and Yennefer, making it a memorable moment in the game. Li Hua described the battle as "super intense" and noted that the emotional stakes for Geralt and Yennefer made it even more powerful.
